Ram Mandir Scandal: Investigation into Alleged Corruption and Employment Scams

The investigation into the Ram Mandir scandal has revealed allegations of corruption and employment scams. The police are investigating claims that employees were hired through corrupt means, with some reports suggesting that the trust's chairman, Anil Mishra, was involved in the process. The police have also found evidence of cash transactions and are questioning suspects.
